configurePresets.name: win64-release
configurePresets.description: MSVC x64 + Ninja Release build of verilator_bin.exe. Run cmake from a Visual Studio x64 developer prompt (vcvars64.bat), otherwise cl.exe is not found and INCLUDE/LIB are unset. flex/bison come from MSYS2; point WIN_FLEX_BISON, FLEX_EXECUTABLE, BISON_EXECUTABLE and FLEX_INCLUDE_DIR elsewhere to use winflexbison instead.
